headline: Visayas Grid Faces Red and Yellow Alerts as Power Supply Tightens
seoTitle: Visayas Grid Under Red, Yellow Alerts August 28 | FMB News
seoDescription: NGCP placed the Visayas grid under red and yellow alerts on August 28 as available capacity fell below projected peak demand.
deck: Available generation in the Visayas fell below projected peak demand as several power plants remained unavailable.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: NGCP placed the Visayas grid under a red alert from 5 p.m. to 8 p.m. on August 28, with yellow alerts before and after the evening red-alert window.
Available capacity was estimated at 2,307 megawatts against projected peak demand of about 2,402 MW.

sections.heading: Why the grid was tight
paragraphs: The shortage reflected the continued unavailability of several generating units and limited electricity imports from Mindanao, reducing operating reserves during peak hours.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: A red alert means supply is insufficient to meet demand and required reserves, increasing the risk of manual load dropping or rotational interruptions.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Consumers and businesses were advised to monitor NGCP and local distribution-utility advisories for changes in alert windows and possible power interruptions.
